examples.text: You can usually get a healthy, cheap breakfast in a restaurant.
examples.translation: 你通常能在餐馆里吃到健康又便宜的早餐。
examples.speechText: You can usually get a healthy, cheap breakfast in a restaurant.

examples.text: As two critics of genetic engineering, Jeremy Rifkin and Ted Howard, state in their book Who Should Play God, Broad scale genetic engineering will probably be introduced to America much the same way as assembly lines, automobiles, vaccines, computers and all the other technologies.
examples.translation: 正如基因工程的两位批评者Jeremy Rifkin和Ted Howard在《谁应扮演上帝》一书中所说，大规模基因工程可能会以与流水线、汽车、疫苗、计算机及其他技术大体相同的方式，被引入美国。
examples.speechText: As two critics of genetic engineering, Jeremy Rifkin and Ted Howard, state in their book Who Should Play God, Broad scale genetic engineering will probably be introduced to America much the same way as assembly lines, automobiles, vaccines, computers and all the other technologies.

examples.text: Although I couldn't have predicted exactly what Nina would do, in three minutes I had assessed（assess的过去分词） her as someone who could not be relied on to get a job done.
examples.translation: 虽然我无法准确预测 Nina 会做什么，但仅仅三分钟后，我就已经判断出她是一个不值得信赖、无法把工作完成好的人。
examples.speechText: Although I couldn't have predicted exactly what Nina would do, in three minutes I had assessed her as someone who could not be relied on to get a job done.

examples.text: Should we attempt to eliminate "inferior" people and breed a "super race"?
examples.translation: 我们应该尝试消灭所谓“劣等”的人，并培育所谓“超级种族”吗？
examples.speechText: Should we attempt to eliminate "inferior" people and breed a "super race"?

examples.text: Stop drinking liquids 1 hour before bedtime.
examples.translation: 睡前一小时停止饮用液体。
examples.speechText: Stop drinking liquids 1 hour before bedtime.

examples.text: I had dreamed about it for years.
examples.translation: 多年来，我一直梦想着这件事。
examples.speechText: I had dreamed about it for years.

examples.text: In this section, you should translate a passage from English into Chinese.
examples.translation: 在本部分，你需要将一段英文内容翻译成中文。

examples.text: Some economists are looking for better solutions to the poverty problem.
examples.translation: 一些经济学家正在寻找解决贫困问题的更好办法。
examples.speechText: Some economists are looking for better solutions to the poverty problem.

examples.text: It does not work as well when your kids get older if their peers (同龄人) do not have landlines, which is why Lundberg has convinced some mom friends to join what she calls her "revolution".
examples.translation: 孩子长大后，如果同龄人没有固定电话，这种方式就不会那么奏效；这也是Lundberg说服几位同为母亲的朋友，加入她所说的“革命”的原因。
examples.speechText: It does not work as well when your kids get older if their peers do not have landlines, which is why Lundberg has convinced some mom friends to join what she calls her "revolution".

examples.text: In early spring, those insects are still sleeping.
examples.translation: 早春时节，那些昆虫还在休眠。
examples.speechText: In early spring, those insects are still sleeping.

examples.text: You can start by coming up with a media plan based（base的过去分词形式） upon your family's priorities and circumstances.
examples.translation: 你可以先根据家庭的重点需求和具体情况，制定一份媒体使用计划。
examples.speechText: You can start by coming up with a media plan based upon your family's priorities and circumstances.

examples.text: Thus for rats, population and violence are directly related.
examples.translation: 因此，对老鼠来说，种群数量与暴力行为有直接关系。
examples.speechText: Thus for rats, population and violence are directly related.

examples.text: Reading can also bring you closer（close的比较级） to your friends.
examples.translation: 阅读还可以拉近你与朋友之间的距离。
examples.speechText: Reading can also bring you closer to your friends.

examples.text: A travel agent can give you information on special economy fares for trains, buses and planes.
examples.translation: 旅行代理可以向你提供火车、汽车和飞机的特价经济票价信息。
examples.speechText: A travel agent can give you information on special economy fares for trains, buses and planes.

examples.text: Its popularity in the United States continues to grow.
examples.translation: 它在美国越来越受欢迎。
examples.speechText: Its popularity in the United States continues to grow.
